plan: Represent quantities and yields as fractions.Fraction throughout; compute a single scale factor target_yield / recipe yield and apply it to every quantity, including substitution-introduced ingredients.
Index the catalog by the 'for' name and select deterministically with min over (priority, catalog_position).

Resolve each excluded ingredient by chaining substitutions until the name is no longer excluded, tracking a visited-name list for cycle detection and multiplying quantity_factor values along the chain.
Buffer chain side effects (wording changes, equipment additions/removals, extra ingredients, yield factor) and commit them only when the chain succeeds.
Process additional ingredients through a work queue that reuses the same resolution path, enabling chained adaptations and re-exclusion detection.
Accumulate reasons and warnings in sets and emit them sorted; check final equipment containment against available_equipment and emit equipment sorted.
Apply committed wording-change pairs as ordered string replacements over instruction strings (top level and components).
Never mutate inputs: build all output structures fresh; print_original returns authored_text unchanged.

Ship an executable __main__ acceptance suite covering scaling 3→5, chained substitution, verb+equipment change, reintroduced exclusion (both impossible and chained-fix), multiple simultaneous reasons, exact original print after adaptations, and priority/tie-break determinism.
